sources.title: LTX 10Eros - v1.4 | LTX Video Checkpoint | Civitai
sources.snippet: BF16 is recommended if you have the setup or the int8 models on huggingface. This model has near-0 anatomy depiction currently. It fully understands the concepts, but my new merge method is a 3 stage comparison shape-level reform lever that mostly aligns to the base 22b model instead of the usual merging methods.

sources.snippet: did a direct swap of eros fp8_learned for this model. takes longer, worse quality, and OOMs at a lower total frame count. If this needs different settings than eros please add them in the post.
